name: ZDR Pursuit Unit
backstory: Three pursuit frames divide close pressure, mobility and measured ranged work. The laboratory tunes the trio together instead of relying on their source-world special abilities.
strategy_personality: Articulated pursuit machines give us a much leaner, more unsettling silhouette than the usual armoured humanoid. Three source units suit the current Trio target without padding the roster. Preserve source colours and limb construction; Samus is not a robot slot. [Nintendo E.M.M.I. report](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/News/2021/June/Metroid-Dread-Report-Vol-2-Researching-the-E-M-M-I-1997672.html).

robots.name: E.M.M.I.-02SM
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 85% of square canvas with breathing room. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.

Subject: Authentic WHITE E.M.M.I.-02SM from Metroid Dread: sleek white armour over exposed black articulated mechanical skeleton, very long jointed arms and legs, narrow high torso, small forward oval head with one central red sensor lens and broad intact white faceplate, claw-like hands and feet. Upright stalking pose with bent limbs and all four extremities visible. Canonical nonhuman proportions, no Samus armour or weapon.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #110 slot 1 E.M.M.I.-02SM.
robots.refinement_note: Trio follows the supplied strategy rule: no weapon refinements. This is an explicit empty plan.
robots.equipment_interpretation: E.M.M.I.-02SM fills the agile contact specialist role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the melee equipment role; offensive stance and a 10% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Trio strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Metroid  
**Strategy:** Trio · **Target roster:** 3 robots
**Catalogue key:** `zdr-pursuit-unit`

**Proposed robots:** E.M.M.I.-02SM; E.M.M.I.-04SB; E.M.M.I.-05IM

**Direction:** Articulated pursuit machines give us a much leaner, more unsettling silhouette than the usual armoured humanoid. Three source units suit the current Trio target without padding the roster. Preserve source colours and limb construction; Samus is not a robot slot. [Nintendo E.M.M.I. report](https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/News/2021/June/Metroid-Dread-Report-Vol-2-Researching-the-E-M-M-I-1997672.html).

**Production edition:** Metroid Dread — 2021 game. Slot order follows the roster above.
purchasing_plan: Open with all three robots. Maintain and tune the trio together; complete stage-1 equipment in slot order. No weapon refinement purchases.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
